onboarding_local_body_two.message: Your data stays on your device or in a folder you choose. No account. No telemetry. Every feature is free.

onboarding_new_tab_blank_desc.description: Description of the Blank new-tab choice.

onboarding_save_essence.message: Inbox gives every unfinished tab a safe place to wait.

onboarding_save_body_one.message: Save one tab or a whole window to Inbox. When you are ready, restore it, add Labels, move it to Archive, or Snooze it for later.
onboarding_save_body_one.description: First paragraph teaching the Inbox workflow.

onboarding_save_body_two.message: Automation can do the routine work. Auto-save moves eligible idle or surplus tabs to Inbox. Suspension frees memory without closing tabs. Snapshots keep recent window arrangements for recovery.

onboarding_find_body_one.description: First paragraph explaining Search inputs and outcomes.

onboarding_find_body_two.message: Labels organize saved pages by topic. Sessions reopen saved windows. Snooze brings something back at a chosen time.

help_inbox_title.description: Help topic title for Inbox and Archive.

help_inbox_essence.message: Save now. Organize when you are ready.

help_inbox_body.message: Inbox holds saved pages that still need a decision. Archive is long-term storage. Both stay searchable.
help_inbox_body.description: Help explanation of Inbox and Archive.

help_inbox_how_one.message: Save one tab or a whole window to Inbox before closing it.

help_inbox_how_two.message: From any saved row, restore, label, snooze, archive, copy, or delete.

help_inbox_how_three.message: Inbox expiry is in Settings under Auto-save. It controls when older untouched items move to Archive.
help_inbox_how_three.description: Inbox Help pointer to the expiry setting without exposing its numeric sentinel.

help_sessions_title.description: Help topic title for Sessions and automatic snapshots.

help_sessions_essence.message: Keep reusable window arrangements and recent recovery points.

help_sessions_body.message: A named Session is a reusable set of windows. Restoring it does not consume it. Automatic snapshots record recent open-window arrangements without becoming named Sessions.
help_sessions_body.description: Help explanation of Sessions and snapshots.

help_sessions_how_one.message: Save open windows as a Session, then restore all windows or one saved page whenever you need them.
help_sessions_how_one.description: Sessions Help instruction for saving and restoring.

help_sessions_how_two.message: When a restored Session window gains new pages, add those addresses or deliberately replace its saved arrangement.
help_sessions_how_two.description: Sessions Help instruction for restored-session changes.

help_sessions_how_three.message: Session groups contain named Sessions only. Automatic snapshots stay outside groups.
help_sessions_how_three.description: Sessions Help explanation of groups and snapshot scope.

help_labels_title.description: Help topic title for Labels and Label groups.

help_labels_essence.message: Use flexible topics across saved pages.

help_labels_body.message: One saved page can have several Labels. A Label follows that saved copy through Inbox, Archive, and Sessions.

help_labels_how_one.message: Add Labels from a row or bulk action, then click a Label to see every matching saved copy.
help_labels_how_one.description: Labels Help instruction for applying and opening Labels.

help_labels_how_two.message: Label groups organize Labels, not the pages inside them. One Label can belong to several groups.
help_labels_how_two.description: Labels Help instruction for group meaning.

help_labels_how_three.message: Choose All, Ungrouped, or one group to change which Labels are shown.
help_labels_how_three.description: Labels Help instruction for group lenses.

help_labels_group_term.description: Reference term for Label groups in Help.

help_labels_lens_term.description: Reference term for All, Ungrouped, and one-group views in Help.

help_search_essence.message: Find open and saved pages from one field.

help_search_body.message: EveryTab Search reaches Open tabs, Inbox, Sessions, Snoozed, Archive, Labels, and groups. Optional browser History joins only after you allow it.

help_search_how_one.message: Inside EveryTab, press / to focus Search. From any Chrome page, type et in the address bar, press Tab, then enter your search.
help_search_how_one.description: Search Help instruction for EveryTab and Chrome address-bar entry. Keep et unchanged.

help_search_how_two.message: Use in:, label:, session:, or domain: to narrow results. Suggestions complete names and domains.
help_search_how_two.description: Search Help instruction for filters. Keep filter syntax unchanged.

help_search_how_three.message: Use Up and Down to move through suggestions and results, Enter to act, and Escape to step back or close.
help_search_how_three.description: Search Help instruction for keyboard use.

help_snooze_essence.message: Bring a page or Session back when it matters.

help_snooze_body.message: Snooze stores a recoverable copy and schedules its return. It can use a preset, custom time, or repeat.

help_snooze_how_one.message: Snooze a tab, saved item, window, or named Session from its action menu.

help_snooze_how_two.message: Overdue items appear in Needs you and stay available in Snoozed until their return is handled.
help_snooze_how_two.description: Snooze Help instruction for overdue items.

help_focus_essence.message: Guard distracting sites for a chosen period.

help_focus_body.message: Choose whether each rule applies during Focus or all the time.
help_focus_body.description: Help explanation of Focus rule scopes.

help_focus_how_one.message: Add sites and choose a default duration in Settings, then start or stop Focus from the shared control.

help_focus_how_two.message: Request temporary access for a guarded page, then add 5 minutes again or stop the allowance from EveryTab.
help_focus_how_two.description: Focus Help instruction for temporary access.

help_focus_how_three.message: At expiry, the current page stays open until you leave or reactivate it, while matching background pages are guarded.
help_focus_how_three.description: Focus Help explanation of expiry safety.

help_focus_note.message: EveryTab can keep a page address, title, and icon. It cannot preserve text typed into the page or other live page state.

help_automation_title.description: Help topic title for automatic behaviors.

help_automation_essence.message: Reduce tab load without losing saved work.

help_automation_how_one.message: Set time and tab-count thresholds in Settings. Each zero value has a specific meaning shown beside that setting, such as Never, Always, No limit, or Keep all.
help_automation_how_one.description: Automation Help instruction for thresholds whose zero values have different meanings.

help_automation_how_two.message: Use exception lists for pages that must stay open or awake.

help_automation_how_three.message: Automatic actions appear in Activity. Reversible actions show Undo while it remains safe.
help_automation_how_three.description: Automation Help instruction for activity and Undo.

help_automation_autosave_desc.message: Moves eligible idle or surplus tabs to Inbox.

help_automation_suspension_desc.message: Frees memory without closing the tab.

help_automation_snapshots_term.description: Automation reference term for automatic snapshots.

help_automation_snapshots_desc.message: Record recent window arrangements for recovery.

help_automation_duplicates_term.description: Automation reference term for duplicate cleanup.

help_automation_duplicates_desc.message: Keeps one copy when the same page is open more than once.
help_automation_duplicates_desc.description: Automation reference explanation of duplicate cleanup.

help_close_day_title.description: Help topic title for Close the day.

help_close_day_essence.message: Review open work, keep what matters, then close safely.
help_close_day_essence.description: Help topic summary for Close the day.

help_close_day_body.message: The review separates restored Session windows, regular windows, and tabs Chrome cannot safely close.
help_close_day_body.description: Help explanation of Close the day.

help_close_day_how_one.message: Choose one outcome per tab, or select rows and apply the same outcome to the selection or whole window.

help_close_day_how_two.message: Review additions to restored Sessions separately from replacing their saved arrangement.
help_close_day_how_two.description: Close-the-day Help instruction for Session changes.

help_close_day_how_three.message: Select Close the day. EveryTab saves before closing. If the process stops, reopen the review to continue. A completed review offers Undo when safe.
help_close_day_how_three.description: Close-the-day Help instruction for commit and recovery.

help_appearance_title.description: Help topic title for schemes and new-tab modes.

help_appearance_essence.message: Choose the look and new-tab page that suit you.

help_appearance_body.message: Color scheme, light or dark mode, corners, row detail, and action labels can be changed independently.
help_appearance_body.description: Help explanation of EveryTab appearance controls.

help_appearance_how_one.message: Choose Dashboard, Minimal, or Blank for new tabs, and choose whether the address bar or EveryTab Search keeps focus.
help_appearance_how_one.description: Appearance Help instruction for new-tab modes.

help_appearance_how_two.message: Star schemes for rotation, or create and share a complete local scheme in the color-scheme editor.

help_appearance_how_three.message: One EveryTab New Tab per window reuses the existing page when Chrome opens another new tab in that window.
help_appearance_how_three.description: Appearance Help instruction for one-new-tab behavior.

help_keyboard_title.description: Help topic title for keyboard control.

help_keyboard_essence.message: Move through lists and act without leaving the keyboard.
help_keyboard_essence.description: Help topic summary for keyboard use.

help_keyboard_body.message: Up and Down move between rows. Left and Right move between controls. Enter uses the focused control, and Escape closes the current menu or step.
help_keyboard_body.description: Help explanation of list keyboard navigation.

help_keyboard_how_one.message: Press / for Dashboard Search and ? for the complete in-page shortcut reference.
help_keyboard_how_one.description: Keyboard Help instruction for in-page shortcuts.

help_keyboard_how_two.message: Chrome commands can open Search or the Dashboard, or save a window to Inbox from any regular page.
help_keyboard_how_two.description: Keyboard Help instruction for default browser commands.

help_keyboard_how_three.message: Optional commands for saving one tab, snoozing, suspending, and opening the side panel can be assigned in Chrome's shortcut settings.
help_keyboard_how_three.description: Keyboard Help instruction for optional browser commands.

help_keyboard_in_page_term.description: Keyboard reference term for in-page shortcuts.

help_keyboard_chrome_term.description: Keyboard reference term for extension commands.

help_data_title.description: Help topic title for data ownership and portability.

help_data_essence.message: Readable data with no account or EveryTab server.
help_data_essence.description: Help topic summary for data ownership.

help_data_body.message: EveryTab stores data locally in Chrome. A vault is an optional folder of plain JSON that you can sync with a file service you already use.
help_data_body.description: Help explanation of local storage and the vault.

help_data_how_one.message: Before a major change, choose Download backup. Restore always shows a preview before it writes.
help_data_how_one.description: Data Help instruction for backup and Restore.

help_data_how_two.message: To share a window, copy it as Markdown. EveryTab can import that Markdown and supported exports from other tab tools.

help_data_how_three.message: Vault sync merges independent records and keeps conflict copies when needed. It does not require an EveryTab account.
help_data_how_three.description: Data Help instruction for Vault sync.

help_history_title.description: Help topic title for optional permissions and privacy.

help_history_essence.message: Optional access is requested when a feature needs it, not at installation.

help_history_body.message: EveryTab does not request browser History at installation. Search and suggestions can use it only after you press Allow in Settings.
help_history_body.description: Help explanation of optional browser History.

help_history_how_one.message: Turn browser History off in Settings to revoke the permission immediately.

help_history_how_two.message: Chrome tab-group names, colors, and collapsed state need the optional tab-group permission when preservation is enabled.
help_history_how_two.description: Permissions Help explanation of optional tab groups.

help_history_how_three.message: EveryTab has no general permission to read page content and does not collect telemetry.

help_safety_title.description: Help topic title for recovery and Undo.

help_safety_essence.message: Know what can be undone and what cannot.

help_safety_body.message: Destructive actions ask for confirmation. EveryTab checks saved data again before writing so it does not overwrite a newer change.

help_safety_how_one.message: Use the visible Undo after a reversible action. You can also open Activity while that Undo is still available.

help_safety_how_two.message: A later edit can make an older exact Undo unavailable. EveryTab says so instead of overwriting the newer data.
help_safety_how_two.description: Safety Help explanation of stale Undo.

help_safety_how_three.message: Download backups and keep a vault if you want recovery outside Chrome's local extension storage.
help_safety_how_three.description: Safety Help instruction for durable backup.
